headline: Require Node 26.13.1, the current LTS, which fixes TLS and HTTP flaws in the modules the toolkit's network clients run on.
summary: The supported Node floor moves from 24.22.1 to 26.13.1, and Node 24 is no longer supported. `pki.transport` and every client built on it send requests through `node:https` and `node:tls`. Node 26.13.1 is a security release that fixes, among others, nested HTTP parser execution from empty writes (CVE-2026-123864), TLS resumption, renegotiation or HelloRetryRequest changing the server name (CVE-2026-123872), and proxy credentials written into an invalid proxy URL error (CVE-2026-123871). Upgrade Node to 26.13.1 or later.

Security: The supported Node floor moves to 26.13.1. `pki.transport.https`, `pki.transport.peerChain` the ACME, EST, SCEP and CMP clients, and the OCSP and CRL fetches in path validation run on `node:https` and `node:tls`. Node 26.13.1 fixes nested HTTP parser execution from empty writes (CVE-2026-123864, High), a session resumption, renegotiation or HelloRetryRequest that changes the server name, and resumption of an mTLS session with no session ID context (CVE-2026-123872, High), Agent TLS policy keys shared across differing options (CVE-2026-123877, Medium), and proxy credentials written into the error for an invalid proxy URL (CVE-2026-123871, Medium). It also updates the bundled Brotli decoder to 1.2.1, which `pki.tls` uses for RFC 8879 certificate decompression. These fixes are in the Node runtime, and updating an npm package does not replace them.
Changed: `engines.node` is `>=26.13.1`. Node 24 is no longer supported. On a lower version npm reports the mismatch as EBADENGINE, and refuses the install where engine-strict is set. Node 26.13.1 ships OpenSSL 3.5.9.

The documentation site image build accepts only a Node 26 base image at 26.13.1 or later. The `NODE_FLOORS` build-arg defaults to `26.13.1`, and the default `BASE_RUNTIME` in `examples/wiki/Dockerfile` is `cgr.dev/chainguard/node:latest` at a digest that carries Node 26.13.1.
